replacements.en:
Headline: "[MAIN_TEXT]"
Subject: [MATERIAL OR OBJECT + ITS STATE]
Camera: [ANGLE + SCALE]
Palette: [ONE SATURATED FIELD + SUBJECT TONES + WHITE TYPE]
Type Interaction: [WHERE THE SUBJECT CROSSES OR SPLITS THE WORDS]
replacements.zh-CN:
标题："[主标题]"
主体：[材质或物体 + 它的状态]
镜头：[角度 + 尺度]
配色：[一个饱和色场 + 主体色调 + 白色文字]
文字互动：[主体在哪里穿过或拆开文字]

replacements.en:
Headline: "WIDE OPEN"
Subject: a weathered concrete arch standing alone in the desert
Camera: low wide angle, the arch towering from the left edge
Palette: saturated sky-blue field + sand and concrete tones + white type
Type Interaction: WIDE sits above the arch; the arch pillar splits OPEN, hiding part of one letter
replacements.zh-CN:
标题："WIDE OPEN"
主体：一座孤立在沙漠中、饱经风化的混凝土拱门
镜头：低机位广角，拱门从左侧边缘高耸而起
配色：饱和的天蓝色场 + 沙土与混凝土色调 + 白色文字
文字互动：WIDE 位于拱门上方；拱门的立柱把 OPEN 拆开，遮住其中一个字母的一部分

replacements.en:
Headline: "SOFT POWER"
Subject: a long vermilion silk scarf twisting in mid-air
Camera: straight on and close, the silk spanning the full height
Palette: deep plum field + vermilion silk + cream type
Type Interaction: the silk weaves in front of SOFT and behind POWER, slipping between the two words
replacements.zh-CN:
标题："SOFT POWER"
主体：一条在半空中翻卷的朱红色长丝巾
镜头：正面近景，丝绸贯穿整个画面高度
配色：深梅紫色场 + 朱红丝绸 + 奶油色文字
文字互动：丝绸从 SOFT 前方绕过、从 POWER 后方穿过，滑过两个单词之间

replacements.en:
Headline: "RAW FORM"
Subject: wet clay rising on a potter's wheel between two clay-covered hands
Camera: low side angle, extreme close-up, the pot filling the lower half
Palette: soft lavender field + earthy brown clay + white type
Type Interaction: the rising clay passes in front of the lower edge of FORM while the hands stay below the letters
replacements.zh-CN:
标题："RAW FORM"
主体：在拉坯机上被两只沾满泥的手拉起的湿陶土
镜头：低侧角度，大特写，陶坯占据下半画面
配色：柔和的薰衣草紫色场 + 土棕色陶土 + 白色文字
文字互动：升起的陶土从 FORM 下缘前方经过，双手留在字母下方

replacements.en:
Headline: "SLOW BURN"
Subject: a single wooden match flaring, its head charred and glowing
Camera: macro, on a diagonal from the lower right, the match monumental in frame
Palette: deep black field + orange flame and pale wood + white type
Type Interaction: the flame rises in the gap between SLOW and BURN; the matchstick crosses in front of BURN
replacements.zh-CN:
标题："SLOW BURN"
主体：一根正在燃起的木火柴，火柴头焦黑发亮
镜头：微距，从右下方斜向入画，火柴在画面中显得巨大
配色：深黑色场 + 橙色火焰与浅色木头 + 白色文字
文字互动：火焰在 SLOW 与 BURN 之间的空隙中升起；火柴杆从 BURN 前方斜穿而过
